palindrome:
Able was I ere I saw Elba - a famous palindrome!

Here is a longer palindrome:

"Madam Arora teaches malayalam"

This phrase, when spelled backwards, spells out the same words. It's a great example of a palindrome because it reads identically forward and backward.

Palindromes are fascinating linguistic constructs that often have rich cultural significance and can be enjoyed for their structural symmetry. They're also used in various programming challenges as an exercise to practice string manipulation techniques!
